from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

def ackf(la, first, pairs, ecn=None, typ=2):
    out = bytes([typ]) + W.v(la) + W.v(0) + W.v(len(pairs)) + W.v(first)
    for g, r in pairs: out += W.v(g) + W.v(r)
    if ecn: out += b''.join(W.v(x) for x in ecn)
    return out

# ACK arithmetic: la=10, first=2 -> [8,10]; gap=2 range=3 -> high=10-2-2... low=8: high=8-2-2=4, [1,4]
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(10, 2, [(2,3)]), width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("ack-basic", tr, {'acknowledged.2.intervals':2, 'acknowledged.2.count':6})
# merged: la=10 first=2 + gap=2 range=2 -> [2,4] wait: high=4 range=2 -> [2,4] -> adjacent to [8,10]? no. count=2+... 
# ranges [8,11) and [2,5): count 5
print("   ack row:", g['acknowledged'][2])

# ack first > la -> FE
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(10, 3, []), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-first>la", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# ack gap arithmetic: low < gap+2 -> FE
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(10, 9, [(8,0)]), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-gap", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# ack range > high -> FE
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ackf(10, 9, [(0,5)]), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-range", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# ecn counters maxima
a1 = ackf(10, 10, [], ecn=[5,1,2], typ=3)
a2 = ackf(11, 11, [], ecn=[3,4,1], typ=3)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, a1+a2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ack-ecn", tr, {'acknowledged.2.ecn':[5,4,2], 'acknowledged.2.count':12})

# ack at I level (allowed) and full-domain span
a = ackf(2**62-1, 2**62-1, [])
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, a, width=4), auth=[0])])
g = check("ack-full-domain", tr, {'acknowledged.0.count':2**62, 'acknowledged.0.prefix':2**62, 'acknowledged.0.intervals':1})
hb = (0).to_bytes(8,'big') + (2**62).to_bytes(8,'big')
print("   hash ok:", g['acknowledged'][0]['sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(hb).hexdigest())

# ACK at level A is fine; RESET_STREAM at I -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION (level), even truncated body
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, b'\x04', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("level-pv", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'closed.offset':0})

# NEW_TOKEN / HANDSHAKE_DONE -> PV at any level
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, b'\x07', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("newtoken-pv", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x1e', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("handshake-done-pv", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})

# nonminimal type -> FE
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, bytes([0x40,0x01]), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("nonminimal-type", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# overlong body varint canonicalized minimally: PING + MAX_DATA with overlong varint
body = bytes([0x10, 0x40, 0x05])   # MAX_DATA = 5 encoded in 2 bytes (overlong)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("overlong-minimize", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'packets.0.sha256': hashlib.sha256(bytes.fromhex('40aa0002'+'0100') if False else bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00,0x02,0x01,0x10,0x05])).hexdigest()})
# canonical: first 0x40, dcid aa, pn 00, payload 01 10 05  (max_data minimal)
print("   canonical hash:", g['packets'][0]['sha256'])

# lengthless STREAM stays lengthless, consumes rest
body = stream(0, 0, b'', fin=False, length=False) + b'hello'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("lengthless-stream", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.ranges':[[0,5]], 'streams.0.prefix':5})
print("   canonical:", g['packets'][0]['sha256'][:12], "expect", hashlib.sha256(bytes([0x40,0xaa,0x00])+bytes([0x08])+W.v(0)+b'hello').hexdigest()[:12])

# CLOSE: prefix committed, trailing ignored
f1 = stream(0, 0, b'ab', fin=False)
close = bytes([0x1c]) + W.v(0) + W.v(0x1f) + W.v(2) + b'hi'   # transport close err0 trigger 31
junk = b'\x99\xff'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, f1+close+junk, width=1), auth=[0]),
            datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1), auth=[0]),
            dict(keys=[])])
g = check("close-transport", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PEER_CLOSE', 'packets.1.status':'CLOSED',
                                  'closed.code':'PEER_CLOSE', 'closed.offset':len(f1),
                                  'used':2, 'keys':['A']})

# app close at I level -> PV ; at A -> PEER_CLOSE
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, bytes([0x1d])+W.v(0)+W.v(0), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("appclose-level", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, bytes([0x1d])+W.v(0)+W.v(0), width=1), auth=[0])])
check("appclose-ok", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PEER_CLOSE', 'closed.code':'PEER_CLOSE'})

# empty payload -> FE at 0
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("empty-payload", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'closed.offset':0})

# accepted prefix across packets in one datagram then error
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1)+envelope('A', 1, b'\x99', width=1)+envelope('A', 2, b'\x01', width=1), auth=[0,0,0])])
g = check("accepted-prefix", tr, {'datagrams.0.accepted':1, 'datagrams.0.packets':3,
                                  'packets.2.status':'CLOSED', 'closed.packet':1})
print("   datagram bytes:", g['datagrams'][0]['bytes'])
EOF
